text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Are you asking for recommendations from 
the Tracen Academy cafeteria menu?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I promised to have lunch with 
my team members next time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the katsu curry a colleague 
recommended to me before was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's so crispy and piping hot, and 
the curry has just the right amount of 
kick!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I'd recommend getting a smaller 
portion. Even though it's meant for 
humans, a single serving is still quite a 
substantial amount.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...No. My apologies, but could I hear 
some other candidates?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... How about the tempura 
set meal?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The chicken tempura is exquisite! The 
eggplant and perilla are fried to absolute 
perfection too—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Huh? I'm sorry, do you dislike both 
of them?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's not that I dislike it, more like—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I had completely forgotten that you're a 
newcomer to the workforce.
